title: Henry Majed (Founder/CEO · Visiting Fellow, Saïd Business School, Oxford) — 'And slowly, by stealth, the means become the mission'
summary: Henry Majed — founder/CEO, Visiting Fellow at Saïd Business School Oxford, keynote speaker on innovation strategy — publishes the most substantive Disruptive Innovators Network recap (13 likes) of the Salesforce Tower morning. Frames Eric's argument as uncomfortable: organizations rarely abandon their purpose in one dramatic moment — they are teased away gradually by incentives, governance structures, and 'financial gravity.' Praises Eric's ability to 'meet people where they are, help them make sense of what they have experienced, and then take them somewhere sharper and more illuminating.'
blockquote: Organisations rarely abandon their purpose in one dramatic moment. They are teased away gradually, by incentives, governance structures and what he calls #FinancialGravity. "Investors won't like this." "The board will expect that." "This is what good governance looks like." And slowly, by stealth, the means become the mission.
